descriptionEn: Suffuse your Quarterstaff with electrical energy, then Slam the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.
summaryPt: Golpe no chão com o cajado em cone. Consome Power Charges pra disparar projéteis de raio — muito mais dano com cargas.
wherePt: Gema inicial do Monk / Uncut Skill Gem (nível 1+).
